answers.how: The bird travels approximately 420 pixels in 2.5 seconds, giving a scale of 6/(420/2.5) = 0.0357 m/pixel. The house measures about 432 pixels from eave to eave.
The bird measures approximately 58 pixels from beak to tail. Using the motion-derived scale of 0.0357 m/pixel gives 2.07 m.
The fully spread wings measure approximately 113 pixels tip to tip. Using the motion-derived scale of 0.0357 m/pixel gives 4.04 m.
